news.title: Memora: A Harmonic Memory Representation Balancing Abstraction and Specificity
news.summary_raw:
AI agents can't remember past conversations. They must constantly reload or retrieve context, which grows less efficient as tasks get longer and more complex. Memora solves this with a scalable memory system separating what’s stored from how it's retrieved.
The post Memora: A Harmonic Memory Representation Balancing Abstraction and Specificity appeared first on Microsoft Research.
news.summary: Microsoft Research introduces Memora, a scalable memory system that allows AI agents to better store and retrieve context.
news.enterprise_use: This new scalable memory system could lead to more context-aware AI in the future, but for now, it doesn't directly affect your IT stack. However, as AI models in tools like Google Workspace or Freshservice become more complex, you might see performance benefits.

news.summary: Enterprise AI organizations have an ownership problem due to expanding AI portfolios, with most governing through manual means. This has led to a widening control gap.

news.title: SkillOpt: Agent skills as trainable parameters

news.summary: Microsoft Research has developed SkillOpt, a technology that turns agent skill editing into a training process.
